operations.setup: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile && pnpm exec rer install
operations.verify: pnpm run verify && pnpm check:deployment-spec && pnpm exec rer check --profile first-party && node scripts/edition-authoring/cli.mjs check && node scripts/edition-authoring/cli.mjs verify-base --offline
operations.recovery: Follow OPERATIONS.md: pause writes and scheduled work, retain exact source and private settings, export D1 and R2, restore into fresh empty resources, establish a fresh owner, re-export and compare supported records and receipt bytes before routing traffic. Preserve applied migration names and bytes.
